basic_details.short_information: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Surat (SVNIT) has announced recruitment for 5 Professor vacancies under advertisement number Estt. /2026/ Prof/1600. Eligible candidates applying for the Professor post must possess a Ph.D. in relevant discipline with first class in preceding degrees, with appointments made on probation for a period of one year at Pay Level 14A. Applicants must complete the online application process starting from 18 October 2026 up to 2 December 2026 (5:00 p.m.), and also send the printout of the signed application along with self-attested supporting docume

application_fee.details: The non-refundable application processing fee must be paid online through the recruitment portal. Fees once paid are non-refundable under any circumstances.

age_limit.details: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged except for candidates with exceptional research and ongoing or approved externally funded research projects. The date for determining eligibility in all respects, including the preferred age limit, qualification, and experience, is the closing date of the online application (02.12.2026).

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in the relevant discipline and first class in the preceding degrees (Bachelor’s Degree onwards). Where first class is not mentioned, at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate is required.

qualification.details: All degrees must be from an Institute/University recognized by UGC, AICTE, AIU, or GOI. Foreign degrees are accepted if from national universities or institutions ranked up to 500 in QS/THE World Rankings. how_to_apply: Open the online recruitment portal at https://svnitrec.samarth.edu.in/ between 18.10.2026 and 02.12.2026 (up to 5.00 p.m.).
Complete the online application form and fill in the credit point summary sheet and details sheet.
Upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (taken within 3 months, without cap, scarf, or sunglasses) along with relevant certificates.
Pay the non-refundable processing fee of ₹1000 online, if applicable.
Submit the online form and download the completed application form along with the credit point summary sheet.
Number and sign all pages of the printed application form, and write the total number of pages on the first page.
Enclose self-attested copies of all testimonials, educational certificates, experience certificates, category proof, and fee payment proof.
Place the documents in an envelope superscribed as "Advertisement No. Estt. /2026/ Prof/1600, Dated 16.10.2026, Department of [Name of Department], Application ID no. [ID]".

Send the packet so as to reach the Deputy Registrar (Establishment), Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Ichchhanath, Dumas Road, Surat – 395 007, Gujarat on or before 09.12.2026 (5:00 p.m.).

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The total number of tentative vacancies for the post of Professor across the departments is 5: 01 (UR), 01 (SC), and 03 (ST). The number of posts may vary at the time of final selection or recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: All degrees must be from an Institute/University recognized by UGC, AICTE, AIU, or GOI. Foreign degrees are accepted if from national universities or institutions ranked up to 500 in QS/THE World Rankings. For candidates with a Ph.D. from SVNIT Surat, a three-year inbreeding gap between Ph.D. notification and the application deadline applies (not applicable to existing SVNIT faculty). rows.qualification: Ph.D. in the relevant discipline and first class in the preceding degrees (Bachelor’s Degree onwards). Where first class is not mentioned, at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate is required.
rows.experience: As per Schedule ‘E’ of the NIT Statute published on 24th July 2017. Experience at the level of Associate Professor with AGP ₹9000 and/or ₹9500 (Pay Level 13A1 and/or 13A2). More than six months of experience in a regular position in CFTI / Institute of national importance / state government funded institute or university / centrally funded lab and organization under CSIR, DRDO, DAE, DBT, DST, DSIR, ISRO, MOCIT, MOEF, MNRE, MOP, MOWR, NPL etc., educational institutions ranked by NIRF up to 100 in overall/Universities/Engineering for any two years, foreign institutions/universities in QS/THE world ranking up to 500, or industrial experience in PSU, autonomous organization, or private industry with turnover of more than ₹500 crores.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post carries Pay Level 14A of the Pay Matrix, with basic pay ranging from ₹159,100 to ₹220,200 per month along with admissible allowances. All appointments are made on probation for a period of one year, wherever applicable. On successful completion and confirmation, appointees hold office until the age of superannuation specified by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Additional benefits include Cumulative Professional Development Allowance (CPDA), provision for industrial consultancy, children's tuition fee reimbursement up to Class XII, LTC, medical facilities for self and dependent family, campus accommodation with nominal licence fee or HRA, coverage under the National Pension System (NPS-2004), and reimbursement of telephone and data charges.

content_sections.heading: SVNIT Professor Age Limit
content_sections.text: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged except for candidates with exceptional research and ongoing or approved externally funded research projects. The date for determining eligibility in all respects, including the preferred age limit, qualification, and experience, is the closing date of the online application (02.12.2026).

content_sections.heading: SVNIT Professor Application Fee
content_sections.text: The non-refundable application processing fee must be paid online through the recruitment portal. Fees once paid are non-refundable under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Age proof 10th marksheet / Grade sheet and/or certificate 12th marksheet / Grade sheet and/or certificate Graduation marksheets / Grade sheets and degree certificate Post-graduation marksheets / Grade sheets and degree certificate Ph.D. degree / certificate Caste / EWS / Disability certificate (in prescribed Government of India format; OBC-NCL certificate issued after 1st April 2026) Ex-serviceman certificate, if applicable Experience certificate mentioning designation, pay scale, and service duration Documents in support of claimed credit points (first page of research papers, patents, projects, achievements, experience) Printout of proof of online application processing fee payment Undertaking in Annexure-III (for candidates having direct Ph.D. after 4-year B.Tech) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer for regular Government/PSU employees

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under SVNIT Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 tentative vacancies for the post of Professor, distributed as 01 for UR, 01 for SC, and 03 for ST across 12 departments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for SVNIT Professor?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 2 December 2026 up to 5:00 p.m., and the hard copy must reach the institute by 9 December 2026 (5:00 p.m.).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for SVNIT Professor?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline with first class (or at least 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale / 60% marks) in all preceding degrees from Bachelor's onwards.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SVNIT Professor posts?
faq.answer: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged, except for candidates with exceptional research and ongoing or approved externally funded research projects.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for SVNIT Professor?
faq.answer: The post is placed in Pay Level 14A of the Pay Matrix, with basic pay ranging between ₹159,100 and ₹220,200 per month along with admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. Who is exempted from paying the SVNIT Professor application fee?
faq.answer: SC, ST, PwD, female candidates, and faculty members of SVNIT Surat are completely exempted from paying the application processing fee.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for SVNIT Professor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applications and shortlisting, followed by a departmental presentation/seminar and a personal interview before the selection committee.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply as a new entrant under the inbreeding rule?
faq.answer: Candidates who obtained their Ph.D. from SVNIT Surat must have a minimum gap of three years between Ph.D. notification and the application deadline, unless they are already faculty members at SVNIT Surat.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be dispatched with the printed application form?
faq.answer: Applicants must send the signed application form, credit point summary sheet, educational marksheets and degree certificates, experience certificates, caste/disability proof, credit point proofs, and fee receipt.
